notes: Hidden board, RUST_CODE.BBS, dial 5550107. Run by an old friend who's drifted toward the enemy's side without explicitly defecting. Reading costs 1 cover per visit in Graustark. Posts cross-reference the enemy's strategic intent. Skeleton — 3 threads.

threads.subject: I am still up the river

op.body:
F. — if you have dialed in, you know who I am and I know who you are. I am still up the river. I am running this board because the people up the river also need a board. The board is small.

I am not going to tell you what to read here. I am going to tell you that what you read here is true. I am not going to tell you what to do with it.

The coffee at the counter on the porch is at 6 PM if you want it. — RH.

threads.subject: next week the HOA is going to push the substrate ratchet in Small Wood

op.body:
Picked up at the porch Friday. The HOA's August schedule got moved up by a week. The substrate ratchet that was on the calendar for August 11 is now on for August 4. The seed-dying template that was meant for July 28 is going to land next Sunday instead.

This is not a secret. The HOA wrote it in their minutes. The minutes are in the city records office. The city records office is on Tuesday hours through August. — RH.

threads.subject: the man at the end of the bar at the Mast in Mobile · the same one

op.body:
chainlinkspiral on OVERPASS posted about a man at the end of the bar at the Mast. The man is the man I saw at the boat ramp in '93 the week of the fire. The man is the man who drove the truck that was at the lumber yard the day Pop's truck got hit.

The man is not on the HOA's payroll. The man is on the payroll of the office that pays the HOA. They are different offices.

— RH.

threads.subject: the seed at the timber yard · what happened

op.body:
Picked up at the porch Thursday. The contact who was rented into the upstairs room at the Lacombe timber yard since March is going to be reassigned. Not by us. By the office of the man from RH_003. They are pulling him out because they think he's ours. He isn't ours. He's just useful.

The pull-out will be in two weeks (August 12). The room will be empty for at most three days before the timber yard rents it to the next occupant on the parish's short-list. Jules will be in a hurry to fill it because Jules is Jules.

The_surviving_son knows how to do the transition. He did the '94 transition. He will do this one if asked. Ask him early. He does not respond quickly to short notice. — RH.

threads.subject: the HC surveillance camera roster · verified independently

op.body:
Independent count of the HC gate cameras · walked the perimeter Saturday 6 AM · matches the WM count from CK_006 at 6 cameras approved for August but I count 7 currently mounted. One is unlogged.

The unlogged camera is on the south fence between the cul-de-sac and the pool. The bracket is new · matte-black · same batch as the four that were approved in July. Someone on the security committee installed a seventh camera between the July and August meetings and did not put it in the minutes.

Mrs Salinas would know. Mrs Salinas may not have been told. I would not walk this back to Mrs Salinas myself; the pipeline is Mrs Delacroix asking Mrs Salinas 'we approved six, right?' in a natural voice next Tuesday.

I am not going to be near the south fence for a while. — RH.

threads.subject: the watch at the Mast is closed · the whiteboard changed

op.body:
Two items. Both cost me something to know. Spend your cover accordingly.

One. The watch at the Mast is closed. The man from the boat ramp sat that barstool every Friday for three months because the office believed somebody was going to come through that door, and Friday the office decided the somebody had already come through a different door somewhere else, and closed the watch. He won a toy out of the claw machine on his way out. I am told he gave it to a child. I have known him since '93 and I am telling you that man does not spend a dollar without instruction, and nobody instructed the lobster. Make of it what you want. I have been making of it all weekend.

Two. The whiteboard in the office I am not supposed to see changed in August. In July the whiteboard held a place. It holds a date now. The date is the Sunday the gulf storm makes landfall. Whatever the August event is, it is scheduled for the hours when every lineman, deputy, and neighbor in three parishes is looking at the sky.

I am still up the river. Some weeks I know why. — R.H.

replies.body: Received. Both. The second one changes the week. The first one — old friend, the lobster was not nothing. Things that are not instructed are the things I still have hope for. You would know. — F.
